tasks.acceptance: Historical. Superseded by SPEC-2026-09-23.md §1 (out of scope). Code removed in T4.

tasks.title: Cleanup — remove annotation-era code
tasks.acceptance: annotations.py, audio_profile.py, prepare.py, preprocess.py, test_annotations.py, and test_preprocess_contract.py are deleted; crop_task_clip is removed from audio.py while read_wav, extract_channel, resample_to_16kHz, AudioPreparationError, and Audio are kept unchanged; test_audio_prepare.py is trimmed to audio-loading/channel/resample tests only; __init__.py no longer imports from annotations; a grep for annotations|audio_profile|preprocess|crop_task_clip under src/say_transcribe and tests/say_transcribe returns nothing; ruff and pytest pass.

tasks.title: PhoWhisper ASR → timed segments
tasks.acceptance: Source WAV SHA-256 is computed and threaded through to the CHAT writer; word-level start_end timestamps are captured per word and threaded through to T9 (%wor), with CHAT_WORD_TIMING_UNAVAILABLE recorded when unavailable; importing say_transcribe does not import torch/transformers; GPU_UNAVAILABLE and MODEL_UNAVAILABLE are distinct tested error paths; unit tests run fully offline against a fake model; the transcribe extra in pyproject.toml covers this task's dependencies.

tasks.title: pyannote diarization draft
tasks.acceptance: Offline unit test with a fake diarizer exercises the talk-time PAR/INV rule; output marks labels as draft; GPU_UNAVAILABLE/MODEL_UNAVAILABLE are reused from T5, not redefined; the transcribe extra in pyproject.toml gains this task's dependency.

tasks.title: Underthesea word grouping
tasks.acceptance: NFC, tone marks, and d/đ round-trip through grouping unchanged; grouping never merges tokens across two different ASR utterances; WORD_GROUPING_UNALIGNED is raised and tested for a syllable-count mismatch; the transcribe extra in pyproject.toml gains underthesea.

tasks.title: Stanza vi → %mor/%gra projection
tasks.acceptance: A Chatter fixture with _-joined words in %mor/%gra validates before any real-Stanza test is trusted; %mor keeps the _ joiner in lemma; %gra enforces the root-head-0/REL==ROOT invariant and the (n+1)|root|PUNCT terminator; comma renders as cm|cm; CHAT_MORPHOSYNTAX_UNAVAILABLE omits both tiers for only the failing utterance; offline unit tests run against a fake Stanza pipeline; the transcribe extra in pyproject.toml gains stanza.

tasks.title: CHAT writer
tasks.acceptance: Chatter validates a synthetic fixture session end to end; round-trip through src/speech_features/formats/chat.py preserves %wor/%mor/%gra content unchanged; %wor carries word-level start_end spans in Delaware shape; the source_sha256 and draft-speaker @Comment lines are present exactly once each; utterances missing %mor/%gra still get a main tier line and bullet.

tasks.title: CLI — diagnose, run, evaluate
tasks.acceptance: [project.scripts] gains say-transcribe = "say_transcribe.cli:main"; [tool.setuptools.packages.find].include covers say_transcribe*; CLI tests cover exit codes 0/2/3/4 per SPEC §5; no dropped v4 error codes appear; no absolute path, transcript text, or raw exception appears in any CLI log/error line.

tasks.title: Evaluator — CER/WER/SyER/DER + bootstrap
tasks.acceptance: Tests run against synthetic reference/hypothesis .cha file pairs, not real corpus data; bootstrap is seeded and deterministic across runs; the report never contains per-utterance text or per-speaker timestamps, aggregate metrics only.

tasks.title: Private GPU pilot
tasks.acceptance: nvidia-smi succeeds on the host (verified 2026-09-23); the pipeline runs on the 5 pilot masters; one Delaware-shaped .cha (main tier + %wor + %mor + %gra) per session is written to the private output dir; metrics from T11 are recorded privately, never in tracked docs; only aggregate numbers (SyER/CER/DER/tier agreement/pass rate) enter tracked docs.
